description: Triage + routing algorithms — how to classify an incoming item (incident, support ticket, alert, lead, agent task) by severity and route it to the right handler/queue/escalation. A registry of triage SPECS (the decision, inputs, when to use, deterministic vs learned), not implementations; pointers, never truth. Generic operational triage (incident/support/alert/lead), NOT medical. Composes with prioritization_algorithms (the score), queueing_disciplines (the destination queue), access_policy_authorization (who may handle), and decision_policy (the thresholds).

triage.name: Severity classification
triage.decision: map an item to a severity band (SEV1..SEVn / P1..Pn)
triage.when_to_use: the first cut on any incident/alert; drives the SLA + escalation

triage.name: Rule-based routing
triage.when_to_use: stable, auditable routing; the floor before any model

triage.name: SLA escalation ladder
triage.decision: escalate to the next tier when an SLA timer breaches

triage.name: Confidence thresholding
triage.decision: auto-handle above a confidence bar, else route to a human
triage.when_to_use: human-in-the-loop gating of an automated classifier (governance bar)

triage.name: Dedup + correlation triage
triage.decision: collapse duplicate/related alerts into one incident
triage.when_to_use: alert storms; cut noise before prioritizing

triage.name: ML classifier routing
triage.when_to_use: high-volume, fuzzy intake where rules under-fit AND labels exist; admit on proven lift, keep the rule floor as fallback

triage.name: Lead/opportunity triage scoring
triage.decision: score + route a lead by fit x intent
triage.when_to_use: sales/ops intake; deterministic-first, learned only on proven lift
